review:
A classic 3x3 Greek game that's easy to pick up – everything pays in threes, including the Zeus wild.

If two reels match but the third doesn't, a Lightning Respin gives you a second chance, and filling the whole grid with one symbol adds a random multiplier up to 10x. Three scatters give 10 free spins. Medium-low volatility, a small 800x cap, 95.5% RTP. A relaxing, low-stakes game.
pros: Lower volatility suits longer, steadier sessions
Bonus lands relatively often (about 1 in 114 spins on average)
Full game playable in the official free demo
cons: Short-session results can differ widely from the RTP
